basic_details.job_title: Jamia Hamdard Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Walkin

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: Desirable Experience: Engineering graphics and design and workshop manufacturing practices, Production Supervisor and Quality Control.

selection_process: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview on the specified date and venue.
Candidates fulfilling the qualifications and experience criteria must appear for a walk-in interview with the prescribed application format
and original documents. Candidates reporting after 03:00 PM shall not be allowed under any circumstances.
how_to_apply: Download the application form and notification from the official Jamia Hamdard portal or reference links.
Fill out the prescribed application format carefully.
Compile your updated CV, original educational certificates, experience certificates, and testimonials.
Organize one set of attested copies of all required documents for verification.
Attend the walk-in interview on 14 October 2026 at the designated venue.
Ensure you report by 02:00 PM and no later than 03:00 PM.
important_instructions: Candidates must submit their details only in the prescribed application format along with attested document copies. Candidates not fulfilling eligibility and experience criteria will not be permitted to appear for the interview. Reporting after 03:00 PM strictly disqualifies candidates from attending the interview under any circumstances. No TA/DA shall be payable for attending the walk-in interview. Remuneration and salary are governed strictly as per Jamia Hamdard norms.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Jamia Hamdard (Deemed to be University) is conducting this recruitment for non-teaching staff on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Jamia Hamdard Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant post on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for Wednesday, 14 October 2026, with a reporting time of 02:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Board Room, First Floor, VC Office, Administrative Building, Jamia Hamdard Campus, New Delhi- 110062.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent degree from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for Jamia Hamdard Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the reporting deadline on the day of the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates shall not be allowed under any circumstances if they report after 03:00 PM on 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA or DA be provided for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA shall be payable for attending the walk-in interview.
